title: Choose availability
note: Shared inactive layout: first arrival, expiry and manual end. Existing wheel alternative remains approved for testing; stepper shown here for continuity.

title: Setting availability
note: Same setup; busy CTA locks duplicate submission. No success popup: transition to active Home.

title: Setup error
note: Same setup; retain selected duration. Inline error and retry.

title: Available
note: Primary request, quiet End availability, Add time alongside countdown. No third footer CTA.

title: Requesting a case
note: Busy CTA. Unknown response uses this same layout with Checking request… and a short connection notice. Reconcile original request before retry.

title: No cases available
note: Same active layout. Explicit retry; no automatic polling.

title: Request error
note: Retry only once server confirms no case assigned. Unknown outcome stays in requesting layout.

title: Offline
note: Availability continues. Mutations need connection; retain selections and reconcile when connection returns.

title: Ending soon
note: Promote Add time inside amber notice at 5 minutes; suppress duplicate timer link. Requests remain eligible until deadline.

title: Add availability
note: Same picker and presets as initial setup. Expiry while open introduces no new UI or action. Add duration to max(server time, current deadline). Failure preserves selection; retry must be idempotent.

title: Adding time
note: Same picker and presets as initial setup. Expiry while open introduces no new UI or action. Add duration to max(server time, current deadline). Failure preserves selection; retry must be idempotent.

title: Add time error
note: Same picker and presets as initial setup. Expiry while open introduces no new UI or action. Add duration to max(server time, current deadline). Failure preserves selection; retry must be idempotent.

title: Added — transient toast
note: Not a separate screen. Return to current Home, update countdown and show toast about 4 seconds; respect native accessibility duration. Preserve previous Home context, including empty queue.

title: End during pending request
note: Conditional confirmation only. Idle End availability uses saving feedback then returns to setup with toast. Confirm schedules stop; dismissal changes nothing.

title: Stop scheduled
note: Persistent status, not toast. Request/case resolves then return to setup. No restart until request reconciled.

title: Window ended with request pending
note: Same pending Home layout. No 0-minute hero or expiry popup. Honor request, then existing case or inactive setup.
